KEY PLAN (all decks and skin; bow right)
Heavy outline: outer skin cut by the plane; the hull sides lean outward with height.
Thin dashed outline: skin and fittings behind the plane (looking starboard).
Grey horizontal lines: deck floor levels across the skin.
Nacelles, deflector, masts, engines: boxes from arch.json bounds.
